name: California State Summer School for the Arts (CSSSA)
org: California State Summer School for the Arts (state program)
city: California (campus not named on the pages read; address on the site is Pomona, CA)
what_you_do: This is a month long, pre-professional summer arts program. Students train in one department. Choices are animation, dance, film and music. Others are theater, visual art, writing, or architecture and environment.
who_can_apply: California residents in grades 8 to 12. Up to 20 students from out of state and other countries may also be enrolled. Each department has its own assignments.
pay_detail: Tuition and fees for California residents were $5,174 for 2026; 2027 rates 'will be posted soon'. Need based aid is available to California residents (nearly half of past students had much of tuition covered). $20 application fee, with fee waivers for students with financial need.
duration: About one month: first day of classes July 5 and graduation July 31, 2027
deadline_text: 2027 application opens in November (timeline lists Nov 1, 2026). Application and scholarship priority deadline is Feb 28, 2027, 6 pm, with no extensions. Session: registration July 3, classes July 5, graduation July 31, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online by department. A full application has the form and two teacher references, not peers. It has an unofficial transcript and department assignments. It has the $20 fee. It has the financial aid request if you want aid. Students can apply to more than one department. Each needs a full application.
notes: Students who finish can get 3 units of college extension credit from the California State University system (per the FAQ). Not a job. The pages read did not name the 2027 campus, so check before planning travel.
